# Sleep Schedule — AI Access Guide
# https://sleepschedule.in

Sleep Schedule provides free, science-based sleep calculators to help people find optimal bedtimes and wake-up times based on 90-minute sleep cycles.

## Tools

- Sleep Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in — Bedtime calculator based on 90-minute sleep cycles
- Nap Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in/nap-calculator — Optimal nap duration and timing
- REM Sleep Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in/rem-sleep-calculator — Estimated REM per sleep duration
- Sleep Debt Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in/sleep-debt-calculator — Sleep deficit tracking
- Sleep Duration Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in/sleep-duration-calculator — Age-based sleep needs
- Pregnancy Sleep Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in/pregnancy-sleep-calculator — Trimester sleep guidance
- Baby Sleep Calculator: https://sleepschedule.in/baby-sleep-calculator — Infant sleep schedules

## Programmatic Pages

- Wake-Up Time Calculators: https://sleepschedule.in/sleep-calculator/[time]-wakeup — Bedtime suggestions for 160 specific wake-up times

## About

Content is based on CDC sleep guidelines and peer-reviewed sleep science research.
